oracle: At each query partition every compatible labeled spanning tree by its exact intersection count and keep a nonempty bucket. Try largest bucket, smallest feasible response and largest feasible response on complete N2..7 graphs with12edge/endpoint permutations and60connected N7 subgraphs. No hidden tree is selected beforehand, but the final single candidate is explicitly checked against every prior response, so each entire transcript is consistent with one fixed hidden tree; this is a stress oracle,not a claim that the original grader is adaptive. Queries and final outputs are checked by degree-one leaf stripping,not production DSU or author BFS.
extraTargetedCases: An explicit unknown triangle disjoint from the hidden star gives two zero exchange deltas and must label the entire cycle0. Two cyclic blocks joined by a bridge check the unexchanged reference bridge is1. Every budget0..needed+2 and every callback-throw position is exercised on a dense N7 hidden star. Every API allocation is failed in turn,with prior external callback effects allowed to persist and a clean fresh call afterward.
memoryScope: Requested live allocation payload for the actual generic N500 complete graph,path reference,hidden star only. Caller inputs/function object,oracle allocations,allocator headers,compiler and ASan overhead are excluded. No universal maximum-byte claim; source adapter storage is separately covered by supplied-checker reproduction.
